High Lady '''Ravashi Paendrag''' was one of Empress [[Radhanan]]'s children.

==History==
She is the eldest daughter of the Empress and Tuon's only older sister.{{Ref/book|11|11}} Tuon is nineteen during [[Crossroads of Twilight]], meaning that Ravashi is no younger than twenty at this point in the books.

She believes that she should have been named [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] because she is older.

== Activities ==
She carried out a number of plots to kill her sister; [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]. Tuon suspects that she is most likely family member to try to have her assassinated.{{Ref/book|11|11}}

She was murdered, along with the rest of her family, by [[Semirhage]].
